strings.privacy.title: Kev ntiag tug
strings.privacy.description: Yuav ua li cas pdff saib xyuas koj cov ntaub ntawv: tsis muaj account, tsis muaj ntaub ntawv khaws tseg, tsis muaj kev tshaj tawm thiab tsis muaj kev muag ntaub ntawv rov qab.
strings.privacy.intro: pdff tsim los kom koj cov ntaub ntawv nyob nrog koj. Nov yog cov lus yooj yim, qhov tshwm sim thaum koj siv.
strings.privacy.sections[0].title: Koj cov ntaub ntawv
strings.privacy.sections[0].text: Lawv raug xa mus encrypted (HTTPS), ua tiav los ntawm lub tshuab, ces muab tshem tawm sai li sai tau cov txiaj ntsig npaj txhij. Cov ntaub ntawv loj mus los ntawm kev khaws cia ib ntus hauv lub npe tsis raug thiab muab tshem tawm thaum ua tiav; kev ntxuav cia ntiag tug tshem tawm txhua yam uas yuav tshuav hauv 24 teev.
strings.privacy.sections[1].title: Tsis muaj account, tsis muaj ntaub ntawv ntiag tug
strings.privacy.sections[1].text: pdff tsis thov sau npe, tsis muaj email thiab tsis muaj credit card. Koj cov ntaub ntawv yeej tsis raug nyeem, txheeb xyuas, qhia lossis siv los qhia kev txawj ntse (AI).
strings.privacy.sections[2].title: Kev ntsuas neeg saib
strings.privacy.sections[2].text: Peb suav cov neeg tuaj saib yam tsis qhia npe thiab tsis muaj cookies (Vercel Web Analytics) los kawm seb cov twj twg pab tau. Tsis muaj kev tshaj tawm, tsis muaj kev taug qab.
strings.privacy.sections[3].title: Cookies
strings.privacy.sections[3].text: Ib qho cookie ib leeg: nws nco ntsoov hom lus koj xaiv.
strings.privacy.sections[4].title: Kev xa mus (Hosting)
strings.privacy.sections[4].text: Lub xaib yog hosted los ntawm Vercel ntawm servers hauv Paris; Word, Excel and PowerPoint hloov kho yog tuav los ntawm Render hauv Frankfurt. Cov chaw muab kev pabcuam no tsuas yog tuav cov ntaub ntawv rau lub sijhawm hloov pauv xwb.
